subject: Quick check: Quarter-end status & approval track for Redwood pilot
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@frontline.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap + next steps (pilot scope & timeline)

Hi Sanjay —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap from my side and a couple of asks so we can lock timing before quarter close: 

- What we covered: 2-week pilot (secure workspace + up to 50k tokens/day), Redwood runtime with prefix caching, and integration options for your ingestion pipeline.
- Your stated goal: prove 3x latency improvement on key generation paths and validate cost profile for scale.
- Open items for Frontline to confirm: budget owner, procurement timeline, and whether SOC2 evidence will be required before pilot kick-off.

Attached: proposal-draft.pdf (scope + SOW draft), mvp-costs.xlsx (cost estimates for options A/B/C), and a screenshot of the trial config we discussed (redwood-trial-config.png).

Ask: can you confirm (a) who signs the pilot SOW, and (b) whether the steering committee meets before July 31 so we can make an EoQ slot? If that timeline doesn't work we can propose a scaled scope that fits an expedited approval.

If helpful I can book a 20-min sync with your procurement and technical lead — here’s my calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ava@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0142

---
Redwood Inference — developer-first inference platform for predictable LLM serving
From: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Post-demo recap + next steps (pilot scope & timeline)

Hi Sanjay —

Just circling back on the note below. Wanted to check if you had a chance to share the proposal with the committee or the budget owner. No rush — just trying to map our EoQ capacity so we can reserve that slot if this is still a priority.

If it helps, I can tighten the scope to a one-week POC (smaller seat count) to make approvals lighter — happy to sketch that out quickly.

Link to the one-click calendar again: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123

Appreciate any status update.

Best,
Ava

Thanks, Ava — appreciate the clear summary. A few quick notes from our side: 

- We did share the deck with procurement and the product steering group, but the steering committee postponed the sign-off until next week because they want an exec readout first.
- Budget is not finalized; there’s a chance we’ll need to carve out a smaller pilot number to get approval this quarter.
- Could you send a 1-page summary + a condensed cost table (single page) that I can include in the exec packet? That would help speed the conversation.

I’ll follow up as soon as I have a date for the exec readout.

Thanks — Sanjay

Subject: Quick check — EoQ timing and priority (short note)

Hi Sanjay —

Thanks for the update — and totally understand the steering committee timing. Quick follow up as we close the month: is Frontline still prioritizing the pilot for this quarter, or should we park the slot and re-open in August? If budget is likely to be the blocker, I can put together a trimmed option that hits the core validation in one week and reduces the ask by ~60%.

If you think the exec readout will land and prize this for this cycle, we’ll hold the EoQ pilot slot but I’ll need a confirmation by Friday 31st to make the GPU capacity commitments. No pressure — just want to make the runway plan transparent so you’re not surprised by resource availability.

Ben, feel free to chime in if you want to propose the trimmed option I mentioned (I’ve drafted it — happy to share).

One more thing: I can produce the one-page exec summary + condensed cost table by EOD today if that helps — do you prefer PDF or a plain slide?

Best,
Ava Chen

ava@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0142
